title: Amount-limited damage redirection encoded as redirecting an entire next event (Eladamri / Vassal’s Duty)
body:
Eladamri and Vassal's Duty drop the amount from “the next 1 damage,” encoding `NextTimeDamageWouldBeDealt...` instead. This redirects an entire damage event: a three-damage event would redirect three damage rather than one.

Only the next one damage should be redirected. Eladamri has no “this turn” expiration; Vassal's Duty does.
